description: Held-out pitch-marking pixels located by eye on frame 0 of the development five-minute clip (storage/raw/matches/1/757559cc56df4d43be4a07ba11068826.mp4, 4096x734 stitched panorama) for calibration 1, whose homography was fitted only on the four pitch corners. Located on 6x zoomed crops with a 10-pixel grid (scripts/evaluate_calibration_landmarks.py crops). Estimated location uncertainty about +/-2 px for high confidence and +/-4 px for medium; low-confidence readings are reported separately. Goal-area corners and penalty spots were not identifiable and are excluded.

confidence.centre_circle_near: medium: arc visible, halfway line occluded by players and extrapolated
confidence.centre_circle_far: medium: arc visible, halfway line partly occluded
confidence.halfway_far_touchline: medium: assumes the white band at the far grass edge is the touchline
confidence.left_penalty_area_far: low: diagonal line end, corner not distinct
confidence.right_penalty_area_far: low: line start, corner not distinct
